name: semantic_coverage_retention
review_scope: Exactly four crate paths for eligible artifact-gap coverage and checked GC retention conversion, isolated on the immutable v3 base. This is scoped code/source admission, not full task or release acceptance.
root_review: Root reviewed the complete exact-scan/coverage changes and fixture, the complete checked-conversion change and fixed retention fixture, both independent peer reviews, the canonical red/green receipts, and the source-bound 013/014 acceptance maps. Root independently re-read the portable archive verifier: 423 originals, 395 archive members, 41 direct files, 770 author source inputs, ten literal inputs and thirteen lifecycle checkpoints verified. Rust execution remains attributable to todo_audit.

validation.strict_scoped_clippy_and_fmt: passed on author sources; not rerun by root

accepted_contract: Eligible missing, corrupt or rejected cache artifacts downgrade otherwise-complete semantic coverage to non-cacheable Partial while retaining valid candidates; hard-scope exclusions occur before counting and previous unavailable/partial reasons keep precedence.
Old Vec scan APIs retain scoring and ordering; genuine I/O/control failures remain errors and no repair I/O is introduced.

Zero GC retention remains rejected. Values above i64::MAX fail with a key-specific Config error before cache-root lookup or provider assembly; the accepted signed value is propagated to explicit GC and disabled semantic remains inert.

Both original newly frozen fixtures remain byte-identical between their red and fixed executions. The only semantic_wiring change after the accepted coverage source is the independently reviewed retention check.
limits: The isolated source has 766 crate/Cargo inputs and was not behavior-run by itself. Author coverage and retention sources had 769 and 770 inputs respectively; exact changed blobs and explicit incremental review are recorded without claiming equal whole trees.
The original P7-013 normal-schedule recovery failure remains open; its isolated diagnostic does not supersede it. This source admission does not grant deadline acceptance.
P7-014 scheduling and conditional GC-counter/log-cap responsibilities remain open; full P7-014, P7-015/016, G7, live semantic quality and release certification are not granted.
Artifact coverage is per scan, not a filesystem atomicity guarantee. The GC retention fix does not resolve mark/unlink races.
Initial shared-target compile failure and noncanonical baseline were preserved separately; neither source hashes nor fresh flags alone certify all transitive build behavior.
